name: Ghalta the Immovable
description: An Echoverse three-horned dinosaur guardian with a cannon-proof hide who migrates farther to face the pirates threatening her kind.

relations.quote: Beckett Brass's dinosaur poachers have been a threat to Ghalta's kind for generations.
